test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: After allowing a discount of 15%, the value of a washing machine is Rs. 29,750. If no discount is allowed, then the shopkeeper gains 12%. The cost price of the washing machine is:
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (S.P) = Rs.29750

Discount (D%) = 15%

**Concept used:**

Discount (D)% = X%

Marked price (M.P) : Selling price (S.P) = 100 : (100 - X%)

Profit (P)% = Y%

Cost price (C.P) : Selling price (S.P) = 100 : (100 + Y%)

**Calculation:**

Discount (D%) = 15%

M.P : S.P = 100 : 85 = 20 : 17

⇒ 17 units = 29750

⇒ 1 unit = 29750/17 = Rs.1750

Marked price (M.P) = 20 units = 20 × 1750 = 35000

Now, if the discount is not given new S.P = M.P

Profit = 12%

C.P : S.P = 100 : 112 = 25 : 28

⇒ 28 units = 35000

⇒ 1 unit = (35000/28) = Rs.1250

Cost price (C.P) = 25 units = 1250 × 25 = Rs.31250

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.31250.**
